name: SPEI-12 drought depth
basis: Vicente-Serrano 2010 SPEI - depth of SPEI-12 below -1 (Thornthwaite PET from ERA5 t2m)

name: Aridity (P/PET)
basis: UNEP 1992 World Atlas of Desertification - semi-arid 0.2-0.5; lower P/PET = drier

name: Rainfall variability (CV)
basis: Nicholson 2017 - East African rainfall among the world's most variable

name: Growing-season failure frequency
basis: IPC/MUCHALI - main season < 80% of normal drives food crises

name: Vegetation/biomass anomaly (NDVI z)
basis: MODIS/Sentinel NDVI anomaly - negative greenness = vegetation stress

name: Soil moisture
basis: Root-zone soil moisture - lower = drier (MoA agromet)

name: Water levels (% of normal)
basis: Reservoir/river levels below normal (MoW gauging)

name: Extreme wet days (>50 mm)
basis: CHIRPS v3 daily - mean annual count of days above 50 mm (heavy-rain trigger)

name: Very-heavy days (>100 mm)
basis: CHIRPS v3 daily - days above 100 mm (very-heavy intensity)

name: River peak above normal
basis: MoW river gauging - flood-stage exceedance height

name: Basin flood records
basis: Basin Water Boards (Rufiji/Wami-Ruvu/Lake Victoria/Pangani...) - recorded basin floods

name: Recorded flood impact events
basis: PMO-DMD/DesInventar - documented flood disasters with impact

name: Landslide susceptibility
basis: GST hotspots (Hanang/Uluguru/Rungwe/Mbeya highlands) - geology + slope

name: Triggering rainfall (max 5-day)
basis: TMA antecedent rainfall - the meteorological landslide trigger

name: Cyclone/strong-wind frequency
basis: IBTrACS - tropical cyclone / strong-wind events on the coast

name: Extreme wind speed
basis: TMA - annual maximum sustained wind

name: Seismic hazard (PGA 475-yr)
basis: GSHAP/East African Rift - peak ground acceleration 10%/50yr

name: Historical seismicity density
basis: GST seismic catalogue - historical earthquake density (Rift belt)

name: Significant wave height (Hs 99th pct)
basis: ERA5/WaveWatch III - extreme nearshore wave energy (monsoon + cyclone swell)

name: Extreme onshore wind
basis: TMA coastal stations - strong onshore wind driving surge and overtopping

name: Storm-surge frequency
basis: TMA - coastal storm-surge / abnormal sea-level events (Kilwa/Mtwara/Dar/Tanga)

name: Shoreline retreat / erosion rate
basis: NEMC coastal monitoring - shoreline erosion (Bagamoyo/Pangani/Dar/Zanzibar channel)

name: Mangrove loss (protective buffer)
basis: NEMC - mangrove decline removes the natural coastal buffer

name: Heat-health days (> 90th pct Tmax)
basis: Mora 2017 Nature Clim. Change - days above a deadly-heat threshold (ERA5 Tmax)

name: Flash density
basis: Albrecht 2016 BAMS - NASA LIS/OTD flash density (Lake Victoria basin hotspot)
